# Load


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(mgcv)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(splines)
library(janitor)

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)

select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r}
GSE234354_counts <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
GSE234354_gene_annotations <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_gene_annotations.rds"))
phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props.rds"))
```


-----

# Normalise counts

For visualisation purposes, remove batch effect

```{r}
rwh_phenotype <- phenotype %>% filter(! is.na(sample_id), ! is.na(ever_pregnant))
exprs <- GSE234354_counts[GSE234354_gene_annotations$ensembl_id,rwh_phenotype$sample_id]
ok <- rowMeans(cpm(exprs) > 0.5) > 0.2
table(ok)
gene_annotation <- GSE234354_gene_annotations[ok,]

y <- DGEList(GSE234354_counts[gene_annotation$ensembl_id,rwh_phenotype$sample_id], 
             genes=gene_annotation)
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
nc <- cpm(y, log=TRUE)
```

```{r}
covariates <- model.matrix(~ rna_batch, data=rwh_phenotype)
nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, covariates=covariates[,-1])

# # Functionally the same as using the batch argument, but intercept for each 
# # gene is slightly different
# nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, batch=rwh_phenotype$rna_batch)
```

```{r}
X <- cSplineDes(rwh_phenotype$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
covariates <- model.matrix(~ X + rna_batch, data=rwh_phenotype)
nc_cc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, covariates=covariates[,-1])
```

```{r}
cl_names <- rwh_phenotype %>% select(starts_with("cl")) %>% colnames()
cl_names
```

# Regularised fit

```{r}
rwh_pheno <- rwh_phenotype
pheno <- rwh_pheno %>%
  mutate(age_scaled=scale(age)[,1]) %>%
  mutate(cycle=case_when(
    time < 9 | time > 99 ~ "men",
    time < 59 ~ "pro",
    TRUE ~ "sec"
  ))  %>% 
  filter(! is.na(ever_pregnant)) %>%
  mutate(group=paste0(cycle, "_", ever_pregnant))
```

```{r}
k_knots <- 30
spline_knots <- list(x=seq(1,100,length=k_knots))
gamma <- 4
batch <- pheno$rna_batch
x <- pheno$time

Sys.time()
fit_summary_list <- lapply(1:nrow(nc), \(i) {
  y <- nc[i, pheno$sample_id]
  fit <- gam(y ~ batch + s(x, bs="cc", k=k_knots, fx=FALSE), knots=spline_knots, gamma=gamma)
  fit_summary <- summary(fit)
  return(c(fit_summary$edf, fit_summary$r.sq))
})
Sys.time()

edf <- sapply(fit_summary_list, \(x) x[1])
quantile(edf, c(0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 0.9999, 1))
hist(edf)

```
